newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African money shortage rises to 10.904 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African money shortage rises to 10.904 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's money market shortage rose to 10.904 billion rand on Wednesday from 10.608 billion on Tuesday, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.

The money market shortage - the amount of money the central band lends to commercial banks for their day-to-day operations - is the highest since the record 10.955 billion recorded on April 30 this year.
South African short-term interest rates are trading at their highest level this year, after kicking up last week as the annual year-end liquidity squeeze bit deeper.
Major banks on Thursday quoted three-month NCD rates unchanged at between 17.40 and 17.75 percent while the 90-day BA rate was also steady at 16.70 to 17.00 percent.
